interface.longDescription: RCC v18.19.7 workflows split across focused skills for Environment Artifacts, providers, trust, coordination/prewarm, RCC core, robot projects, Robot Framework suites, RPA Framework automation, work items, Action Server packages, and CI maintenance. Includes an optional offline Tealdeer quick reference: opt in to managed tldr rcc setup, preserve existing custom pages, and synchronize opted-in marketplace pages at session start after upgrades. Tealdeer must already be installed. The optional Dagger MCP server can be enabled or disabled independently.
defaultPrompt: Show me the RCC quick reference with Tealdeer.
Enable optional tldr rcc integration and its managed session-start sync, adopting an existing canonical symlink without replacing it.
Inspect an RCC artifact provider or prewarm workflow.
Build or debug an RCC automation with RPA Framework.
Use the bundled Dagger MCP server to inspect or run an RCC Dagger module.
